It consists of a fixed part, created to be adaptable through a specific handlebar mounting kit, and a movable part serving as a holder for the mirror glass. description: Designed to disappear. Born to go beyond. Engineered for supersport motorcycles, Stealth Sport is created to minimize visual impact and dominate the air. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Designed to disappear. Born to go beyond. Engineered for supersport motorcycles, Stealth Sport is created to minimize visual impact and dominate the air.

Three elements: a fixed base integrated into the fairing, an adjustable arm for folding the mirror inward and a movable body that houses the glass. With a single motion, the structure compacts, transforming the mirror into an aerodynamic wing. The result: tangible downforce, up to 4 kg at 300 km/h. Milled from a single block of aluminum and finished with deep anodization, it features a convex HD blue-tinted lens for a sharp, glare-free view.

Warning: The Rizoma Stealth mirror is not certified compliant.

Stealth's design, with its wing-like shape and 25° angle relative to the ground, give it a linear look, ensure it generates downforce, in turn improving the bike's grip and handling performance, especially at high speed. Downforce pressure is around 4 kg at 300 km/h.
The ergonomics has been optimized as well: when the rider takes a sporty riding position, the mirrors are aligned with the rider's eye level. In this way, the rider does not have to raise his position to get a correct rear view, keeping the head protected by the headlight fairing and, therefore, by the pressure that impacts the face at high speed.

On bikes that, as standard equipment, have rear-mirrors with integrated turn signals, Rizoma recommends to buy, in combination with Stealth, the Light Unit turn signals (part nr. TS070BM) to allow the front turn signals repositioning. Please check the appropriate mounting and wiring kit required to properly install Light Unit on your bike (to buy separately).

name: Rizoma Stealth Mirrors for BMW S 1000 RR 2025
source_title: Rizoma Stealth Mirrors for BMW S 1000 RR 2025
description: Designed to disappear. Born to go beyond. Engineered for supersport motorcycles, Stealth Sport is created to minimize visual impact and dominate the air. Available in multiple sizes and/or colours — select your variant.
source_description_html:
Designed to disappear. Born to go beyond. Engineered for supersport motorcycles, Stealth Sport is created to minimize visual impact and dominate the air.

Two elements: a fixed base integrated into the fairing and a movable body that houses the glass. With a single motion, the structure compacts, transforming the mirror into an aerodynamic wing. The result: tangible downforce, up to 4 kg at 300 km/h. Milled from a single block of aluminum and finished with deep anodization, it features a convex HD blue-tinted lens for a sharp, glare-free view.

Warning: The Rizoma Stealth mirror is not certified compliant.

Stealth's design, with its wing-like shape and 25° angle relative to the ground, give it a linear look, ensure it generates downforce, in turn improving the bike's grip and handling performance, especially at high speed. Downforce pressure is around 4 kg at 300 km/h.
The ergonomics has been optimized as well: when the rider takes a sporty riding position, the mirrors are aligned with the rider's eye level. In this way, the rider does not have to raise his position to get a correct rear view, keeping the head protected by the headlight fairing and, therefore, by the pressure that impacts the face at high speed.

On bikes that, as standard equipment, have rear-mirrors with integrated turn signals, Rizoma recommends to buy, in combination with Stealth, the Light Unit turn signals (part nr. TS070BM) to allow the front turn signals repositioning. Please check the appropriate mounting and wiring kit required to properly install Light Unit on your bike (to buy separately).

It consists of a fixed part, created to be adaptable through a specific handlebar mounting kit, and a movable part serving as a holder for the mirror glass.
